text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Paging: Elevated 5xx rate from edge gateways in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 — suspected TLS handshake failures. PagerDuty alert triggered.

pagerduty: :rotating_light: on-call lara, you have a P1: gateway-handshake-spike (ticket PD-84321). Respond with ack + initial ETA.

lara: acked. jumping in. seeing spikes in 502/524 from the edge LB. grabbing logs now. ETA 5m.

sam: reporting from runtime — we have a deployment from the rotator yesterday that replaced intermediate certs for several gateways. Could be related.

chris: security side — any chance the rotation used a cert chain missing SANs or wrong EKU? We saw a similar mismatch in staging last month.

maria: customer-support reporting multiple customers hitting API timeouts and 5xx when calling hosted inference endpoints. Some requests failed TLS at the LB: "handshake_failure" in logs.

lara: sharing initial grep:```
  2026-03-15T09:21:02Z edge1 gw: TLS handshake failed: certificate verify failed (unknown_ca)
  2026-03-15T09:21:07Z edge2 gw: TLS handshake failed: unexpected_message
  2026-03-15T09:21:15Z edge3 gw: TLS alert 40
```

sam: can you paste the rotator job id? I want to check what chain was pushed.

lara: rotator job id `rot-2026-03-14-2301`. pulling artifacts.

devops-rotator: automated message: rotation rot-2026-03-14-2301 completed at 2026-03-14T23:01:12Z. Targets: edge-gw-eu, edge-gw-us. CA chain: ca-prod-v3 -> intermediate-2026-03 -> leaf.

chris: looking at the pushed chain. intermediate-2026-03 has CA bit set? hmm not a proper CA (basicConstraints CA:FALSE). That would break clients expecting a CA-signed intermediate.

sam: confirmed. The intermediate cert in the bundle has CA:false. Clients enforcing strict chain validation will reject it. That explains unknown_ca on some ciphers and handshake failures on others.

lara: mitigation options: 1) revert to previous cert bundle (safe, quick) 2) modify LB to accept the incomplete chain (risky) 3) steer traffic to legacy region. I'd prefer revert then gradual re-roll.

maria: support: customers on older TLS stacks (mobile SDKs) are impacted most. Need communication plan.

sam: I'll prepare a revert of rot-2026-03-14-2301 artifacts. How long to rollout? ~3min per region for deploy + 10m to observe.

lara: do it. set canary to one edge node first (edge1 eu-west-1). I'll watch metrics and traces.

devops-rotator: initiating rollback to rot-2026-03-13-1847 on edge-gw-eu-edge1. Rolling...

lara: canary succeeded on edge1, handshake errors dropped to baseline. pushing to rest of eu-west-1 now.

maria: noted immediate drop in customer error reports for eu region. us-west-2 still impacted.

sam: rolling rollback to us-west-2. Doing a staggered push to avoid flapping.

chris: follow-up: we need postmortem and fix in rotation CI to validate basicConstraints and EKU for intermediates. Also add a pre-check that the chain contains a CA:true intermediate.

lara: agreed. For now mitigation worked. Current live status: 5xx spike resolved in eu-west-1 and decreasing in us-west-2.

pagerduty: Incident severity updated to Sev2 — customer impact limited after rollback; continue monitoring.

maria: drafting a short customer note: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors from TLS handshake validation for some clients between 09:20–09:50 UTC. We rolled back a certificate rotation and service levels returned to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with details." Any additions?

chris: include that affected clients include older TLS/SDK versions due to stricter chain validation. We'll recommend updating SDKs where applicable.

sam: action items: 1) rotation CI check for CA:true in intermediates (owner: sam) 2) add post-deploy validation for edge nodes to run handshake test against public endpoints (owner: lara) 3) update runbook with rollback steps and contact list (owner: maria)

lara: I'll remain on call for 2 hours for monitoring and handoff. If metrics stable after that we can close.

maria: support will send the customer note and open tickets for affected accounts.

devops-rotator: rotation service flagged candidate artifact `intermediate-2026-03` as "nonconformant" for follow-up.

sam: quick note — we also observed a small number of TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure) that correlated with ciphers using client cert verification. We'll audit mTLS policy enforcement in the next 48h.

chris: I'll create the security postmortem section for mis-signed intermediates.

lara: thanks all. continuing monitoring. if anything new pops up, call me directly. :phone:

incident-bot: Incident thread created: 2626001234. Please follow the post-incident checklist and fill in timeline in the doc once stabilized."
